findings.detail: http://localhost:3000/main.js constructs OAuth 2.0 authorization URL `${Wx}?client_id=${this.clientId}&response_type=token&scope=email&redirect_uri=${this.redirectUri}` without a session-bound CSPRNG 'state=' parameter (0 bits entropy; violates RFC 9700 §4.7 / CWE-352).

http://localhost:3000/main.js callback handler processes OAuth return parameters (parseRedirectUrlParams().access_token) without validating 'state' against user-agent session storage (accepts omitted, replayed, modified, or cross-session callbacks — CWE-352).

frontend/src/app/login/login.component.ts constructs OAuth 2.0 authorization URL `${oauthProviderUrl}?client_id=${this.clientId}&response_type=token&scope=email&redirect_uri=${this.redirectUri}` without a session-bound CSPRNG 'state=' parameter (0 bits entropy; violates RFC 9700 §4.7 / CWE-352).

frontend/src/app/oauth/oauth.component.ts callback handler processes OAuth return parameters (parseRedirectUrlParams().access_token) without validating 'state' against user-agent session storage (accepts omitted, replayed, modified, or cross-session callbacks — CWE-352).

Semgrep rule casa-assessment.rules.CASA3-OAU-04-missing-state-or-weak-prng flagged frontend/src/app/login/login.component.ts:149 (OAU-04: OAuth 2.0 authorization request omits session-bound CSPRNG state or uses weak non-CSPRNG randomness (RFC 9700 §4.7; CWE-352)).
